gaps.sentence: The novel is a ___ (FICTION) account of real events.
The sculpture is a ___ (MASTER) piece of the Renaissance.
gaps.explanation: 'Masterpiece' = master + piece, written as one word here split by the gap: master… piece.
'A tendency to do something' — noun from tend.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (SUSPECT) of fraud last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Was suspected of' — passive; 'suspicious' describes a person who suspects.
'Studying management' — the field is called management.

gaps.sentence: He spoke ___ (CONFIDENT) in front of the camera.

gaps.explanation: 'Argument' — note the e is dropped from argue.

gaps.sentence: The report was highly ___ (CRITICISE) of the ministry.
gaps.explanation: 'Be critical of' — adjective; 'criticism' is the noun.
